options: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><msup><mn>30</mn><mo>∘</mo></msup><mo>,</mo><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><msup><mn>30</mn><mo>∘</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(\cos 30^\circ, \sin 30^\circ)</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mfrac><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo>,</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}, \frac{1}{2}\right)</annotation></semantics></math>.

This is the point at <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mn>60</mn><mo>∘</mo></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">60^\circ</annotation></semantics></math>: the coordinates are swapped.
This is the point at <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mn>45</mn><mo>∘</mo></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">45^\circ</annotation></semantics></math>.

<math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mfrac><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>3</mn><mn>4</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\right)^2 = \frac{3}{4}</annotation></semantics></math>, so this point is not even on the circle.
